content.text: Almost. Canadian guidance is to start solids around 6 months, so Theo is about a month out. Until then, milk is still all he needs. You can use the time to watch for readiness signs. Can he sit with support and hold his head steady? Does he reach for your food? Has he lost the reflex that pushes food out with his tongue? Iron-rich foods like meat, tofu or iron-fortified cereal usually go first. This is general guidance, so confirm timing with your provider or public health.
